name: Infund Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Infund Holding Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sales of copper clad laminates, feed, and veterinary vaccines and related technical services in China. The company offers copper-clad laminates and bonding sheets for consumer electronics, computers, communications, and automotive electronics. It also provides vaccines for pigs, including blue ear, pseudorabies, porcine viral diarrhea and mycoplasma pneumonia diseases. In addition, it offers equity investment, asset management, external investment; and feed, biological vaccines. Infund Holding Co., Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
